versions.changelog: The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

voice-cloning-studio 0.1.9

- Improved documentation and usage guidance in SKILL.md, now specifying direct sample model card access via beatra.models.list with code snippets.
- Clarified requirements for reading text-to-speech model cards using beatra.models.list {"capability":"text_to_speech"} for compatible voices.
- Updated process details and sample handling instructions for better clarity and accuracy.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.
- Miscellaneous minor documentation and reference updates for workflow and consent procedures.
Ask for a top-up before the voice is cloned, using the live clone price and the starter pack.
Publish the reviewed AI Voice Cloning Studio workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
